response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong credentials in TypeScript, Node.js, and web platforms, but the role requires deep hardware-oriented expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no experience in computer architecture, GPU/accelerator workloads, deep-learning performance optimization, or silicon modeling, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite strong general engineering seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with senior/staff-level roles
Some low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers at Sociomantic)
Brief C/C++ systems experience at National Instruments and embedded exposure
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or silicon design experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/accelerator workload background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, not performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DL workload expertise
General engineering seniority and some performance work
